places.name: Australian War Memorial
places.ai_summary: The Australian War Memorial is a national shrine, museum, and research center dedicated to honoring the sacrifices of Australians in war. It features exhibitions, memorials, and a serene Roll of Honour courtyard.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day.

places.place_tip: Attend the Last Post Ceremony held daily at 4:55 PM.
places.address: Treloar Crescent, Campbell ACT 2612, Australia

places.name: Parliament House
places.ai_summary: Parliament House is the seat of the Australian government, known for its modern architecture and public accessibility. Visitors can explore the chambers, exhibitions, and enjoy panoramic views from the rooftop.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during parliamentary sessions.

places.place_tip: Book a guided tour to learn about Australia's political history.
places.address: Parliament Drive, Canberra ACT 2600, Australia

attribution.title: Parliament House at dusk, Canberra ACT
attribution.author: Thennicke

places.name: National Gallery of Australia
places.ai_summary: The National Gallery of Australia houses an extensive collection of Australian and international art, including paintings, sculptures, and decorative arts. The gallery is known for its Indigenous Australian art collection.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Indigenous Australian art section.
places.address: Parkes Place, Parkes ACT 2600, Australia

attribution.title: National Portrait Gallery building, ACT - perspective controlled
attribution.author: Thennicke
attribution.description: The National Portrait Gallery building, Canberra ACT.

places.name: National Museum of Australia
places.ai_summary: The National Museum of Australia explores the history, culture, and environment of Australia through innovative and interactive exhibitions. The museum is located on the shores of Lake Burley Griffin.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

places.place_tip: Check out the interactive exhibits for an engaging experience.
places.address: Lawson Crescent, Acton Peninsula, Canberra ACT 2601, Australia

places.name: Lake Burley Griffin
places.ai_summary: Lake Burley Griffin is an artificial lake in the heart of Canberra, offering recreational activities and scenic views. The lake is surrounded by parks, gardens, and walking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a picnic by the lake or take a boat ride.
places.address: Canberra ACT 2600, Australia

places.name: Questacon - National Science and Technology Centre
places.ai_summary: Questacon is an interactive science museum in Canberra, featuring hands-on exhibits, live demonstrations, and educational programs. It's a great place for families and science enthusiasts.
places.name_english: Questacon - National Science and Technology Centre

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and ANZAC Day.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for live science demonstrations.
places.address: King Edward Terrace, Parkes ACT 2600, Australia

places.name: National Portrait Gallery
places.ai_summary: The National Portrait Gallery in Canberra showcases portraits of notable Australians, featuring a diverse range of artistic styles and mediums. The gallery offers insights into the lives and achievements of influential Australians.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for in-depth stories behind the portraits.
places.address: King Edward Terrace, Parkes ACT 2600, Australia

attribution.title: National Portrait Gallery building, ACT - perspective controlled

places.name: Australian National Botanic Gardens
places.ai_summary: The Australian National Botanic Gardens in Canberra display a vast collection of native Australian plants in a beautifully landscaped setting. The gardens aim to educate visitors about Australia's unique flora.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens' walking trails for a closer look at the plants.
places.address: Clunies Ross Street, Acton ACT 2601, Australia

places.name: Mount Ainslie Lookout
places.ai_summary: Mount Ainslie Lookout offers panoramic views of Canberra and its surrounding areas. It's a popular spot for both tourists and locals, providing a great vantage point to appreciate the city's layout and natural beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos of the city.
places.address: Mount Ainslie, ACT 2602, Australia

attribution.title: Mount Ainslie
attribution.author: Bidgee

places.name: National Arboretum Canberra
places.ai_summary: The National Arboretum Canberra is a collection of significant trees from Australia and around the world, set in a beautiful landscape. The arboretum features walking trails, a café, and stunning views of the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

places.place_tip: Visit the Village Centre for information and refreshments.
places.address: Forest Drive, Molonglo Valley ACT 2611, Australia

places.name: National Library of Australia
places.ai_summary: The National Library of Australia is the country's largest reference library, holding an extensive collection of books, manuscripts, and other materials. The library also features exhibitions and events related to Australia's literary and historical heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Explore the Treasures Gallery for unique items from the collection.
places.address: Parkes Place, Parkes ACT 2600, Australia

places.name: Royal Australian Mint
places.ai_summary: The Royal Australian Mint is where all of Australia's circulating coins are produced. The mint offers guided tours, a museum, and a chance to see coin production in action.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Check the mint's schedule for coin production times.
places.address: Denison Street, Deakin ACT 2600, Australia

places.name: Museum of Australian Democracy at Old Parliament House
places.ai_summary: The Museum of Australian Democracy at Old Parliament House offers an insight into Australia's political history, featuring exhibits on democracy, governance, and the role of Parliament. The museum is located in the historic Old Parliament House building.
places.name_english: Museum of Australian Democracy at Old Parliament House

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for a comprehensive understanding of Australia's political system.
places.address: 18 King George Terrace, Parkes ACT 2600, Australia

places.name: Telstra Tower
places.ai_summary: Telstra Tower is a telecommunications tower in Canberra, offering panoramic views of the city and surrounding areas. The tower features an observation deck, café, and a gift shop.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the 360-degree views from the observation deck.
places.address: Telstra Tower, Black Mountain ACT 2601, Australia

places.name: Cockington Green Gardens
places.ai_summary: Cockington Green Gardens is a miniature village and railway in Canberra, featuring meticulously crafted miniature buildings and landscapes. The gardens offer a unique and whimsical experience for visitors of all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and ANZAC Day.

places.place_tip: Take a ride on the miniature train for a unique perspective of the gardens.
places.address: 11 Gold Creek Road, Nicholls ACT 2913, Australia

places.name: Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve
places.ai_summary: Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve is a protected area near Canberra, showcasing Australia's native wildlife and natural landscapes. The reserve offers walking trails, wildlife viewing, and educational exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

places.place_tip: Visit the Tidbinbilla Visitor Centre for information and exhibits.
places.address: Tidbinbilla Road, Paddys River ACT 2611, Australia

places.name: National Dinosaur Museum
places.ai_summary: The National Dinosaur Museum in Canberra is dedicated to showcasing Australia's prehistoric life, featuring a vast collection of dinosaur fossils, models, and interactive exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed information about the exhibits.
places.address: 6 Gold Creek Road, Nicholls ACT 2913, Australia

places.name: High Court of Australia
places.ai_summary: The High Court of Australia is the country's highest court, established to interpret and apply the law of Australia. The court is located in Canberra and is an important part of Australia's judicial system.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Attend a court session to observe the legal process.
places.address: Corner of Parliament Drive and National Circuit, Barton ACT 2600, Australia

places.name: National Carillon
places.ai_summary: The National Carillon is a bell tower located in Canberra, containing 55 bells. The carillon is used for musical performances and special events, and it offers a unique auditory experience.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for carillon performances.
places.address: Wellington Avenue, Canberra ACT 2602, Australia

places.name: Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex
places.ai_summary: The Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex is a facility of NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, located in Canberra. It supports interplanetary spacecraft missions and is involved in space science and exploration.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about space missions and technology.
places.address: NASA Deep Space Communication Complex, Tidbinbilla ACT 2611, Australia

attribution.title: CSIRO ScienceImage 11042 Aerial view of the Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex
attribution.author: Robert Kerton, CSIRO
attribution.description: The Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex (CDSCC), located at Tidbinbilla, just outside Canberra, is one of three Deep Space Network stations around the world providing continuous, two-way radio contact with spacecraft exploring our solar system and beyond. The CDSCC is part of NASA's Deep Space Network (DSN) which provides continuous radio contact with spacecraft. Similar facilities are located in Spain and the United States of America. The complex, managed and operated by CSIRO, consists of one 70 metre, two 34 metre and one 26 metre radio telescope antennas with two-way communication capacity.
